meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Nightwave Plaza: hides the News window, blurs or hides cover art and track text, can hide visualizer, listener count and taskbar
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome on https://plaza.one/ with an iPhone UA and a desktop UA; both received the same Vue app (a Windows 98 style desktop with two windows).

- **News window**: `#window-news` 1 (LIVE); it was open on load and positioned absolutely over the page.
- **Cover**: `#window-player .cover` 1 (a CSS background-image div) (LIVE).
- **Track text**: `.player-artist` and `.player-title` 1 each (LIVE).
- **Visualizer** `canvas.player-visual` 1; **status bar** `#window-player .win-window__statusbar` 1; **taskbar** `.win-taskbar-wrapper` 1 (LIVE).

Not verified: the About, Play History, Ratings and Support windows (they open on click), the mobile minimized-window layout beyond the first load, and any ad (none rendered). Classes are plain readable names (`win-window`, `player-meta`); no hashed names are used. Hiding the taskbar also hides the clock and the Start menu button.
